blocks.text: JERUSALEM — A plane heading to Tel Aviv from Dubai was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday, after one of the pilots allegedly tried to crash the plane and kill everyone onboard. Flight FZ 1703 took off from Dubai at 0305 GMT. Here’s what we know about what unfolded on board: 0521 GMT. Sudden loss of altitude The aircraft suddenly plummeted a little over two hours into the flight.
